# Kirk Wessman

> Customer-facing solutions engineer for enterprise AI systems: discovery, architecture, evals, and security review. Los Angeles, with a lot of time in San Francisco and New York.

I'm a customer-facing solutions engineer. I spent the last seven-plus years at Conga, a top-two Salesforce ISV, in the space between enterprise customers and the product: cross-vertical, with the most depth in financial services, tech, and health and life sciences. Before Conga, I spent six years at S&P Global, owning roadmap, pricing, and go-to-market for enterprise API and data-feed products, then managing a portfolio of investment banking and private equity clients.

## Projects

- [PortKey](https://kirkwessman.com/projects/portkey) (live): Carry your low-rate mortgage to your next home. Three model providers, evaluated in public. Eval results: https://portkey-one.vercel.app/evals
- [fareTrader](https://kirkwessman.com/projects/faretrader) (demo, sample data): An agent that watches Delta first-class fares and books the drop.
- [ResourXe](https://kirkwessman.com/projects/resourxe) (live): Routes GPU workloads to the cheapest compute, the greenest, or a blend.
- [Save the State](https://kirkwessman.com/projects/savethestate) (demo): Land covenants on-chain, verifiable without a central authority.
- [StatTrack](https://kirkwessman.com/projects/stattrack) (intermittent): NBA analytics, from raw API to interactive dashboard.
- [re-open.us](https://kirkwessman.com/projects/reopen) (live): Civic engagement landing page challenging political apathy and calling for renewed democratic participation.
- [Prince of Mulberry](https://kirkwessman.com/projects/pmp) (live): Coming soon page for a Nolita-based film production company.
